svg.title: B-spline Policy inference on the NexArm
svg.desc: The cameras and the joint state condition a Diffusion Policy UNet, which denoises one cubic B-spline segment: 16 knots in one column and the control points in the others. Each basis function is non-zero over four knot spans, so moving one control point changes the curve only locally. The controller samples the curve at 100 Hz and can traverse it n times faster; the next segment is entered at the point that matches the last executed action.
svg.text: BSP predicts a curve, not a list of actions.

g.text: 4 · the curve is a weighted sum

svg.text: source · Han, Xiong et al. 2026, B-spline Policy (arXiv 2607.09648) · toy joint trajectory · click a block or use the arrow keys
